WARNING: VIDEO CONTENT⚠️

#MSNews │A bus caught fire near the EDSA westbound intersection on P. Tuazon Boulevard in Quezon City around 6:45 p.m. No injuries have been reported at press time. 

The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority is working to clear the area and restore traffic flow, with personnel from the Bureau of Fire Protection and quick response team on site. │ Joel Zurbano

🎥: MMDA
